findings.description: At 00:04 a ball with a distinctly orange hue is visible in the bowl, clearly different in color from the red ball directly beside it under identical lighting. In all earlier frames (00:00-00:02) and later frames (00:06-00:10) every ball is red, green, or yellow; no orange ball is ever added or removed by a visible action. This is an unexplained color transformation (or momentary appearance/disappearance) of a ball.
